judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Anita Sumanth, J.:— Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the Writ Petition and has also made an endorsement in this regard. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is thus dismissed as withdrawn. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed. No costs.
